title: Bad Bitches in Stasis
description: A surreal stained-glass style painting of a woman with fractured multicolored skin in blue, green, and black, wrapped in white bandages, leaning on a kitchen counter. Behind her stand a blue demon with horns touching her shoulder and a mummy with glowing yellow eyes, under a hanging Tiffany lamp with occult imagery. The background features red graffiti text reading 'BAD BITCHES IN STASIS' and 'KEEP CALM AND'.
